name: pocketeng-desktop
description: Pocket Eng desktop app — Electron shell around console.pocketeng.ai

scripts.test:unit: bun run build:ts && node --test dist/main/deep-link-url.test.js dist/shared/platform.test.js
scripts.build:unsigned: bun run build:ts && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac -c.mac.identity=null --publish never
scripts.build:win:unsigned: bun run build:win:x64:unsigned && bun run build:win:arm64:unsigned
